pending-write.source: const fs = require("fs"); const s = new fs.Utf8Stream({ dest: "/work/lifetime/a.log" }); for (let i = 0; i < 64; i += 1) s.write("x".repeat(16383) + "\n"); process.on("exit", () => console.log(JSON.stringify({ size: fs.statSync("/work/lifetime/a.log").size, writing: s.writing })));

buffered-at-exit.source: const fs = require("fs"); const started = Date.now(); const s = new fs.Utf8Stream({ dest: "/work/lifetime/b.log", minLength: 100, periodicFlush: 60000 }); s.write("never written\n"); process.on("exit", () => console.log(JSON.stringify({ size: fs.statSync("/work/lifetime/b.log").size, early: Date.now() - started < 5000 })));

retry-timer.source: const fs = require("fs"); let fail = true; const s = new fs.Utf8Stream({ dest: "/work/lifetime/c.log", fs: { write(fd, data, encoding, callback) { if (fail) { fail = false; callback(Object.assign(new Error("again"), { code: "EAGAIN" })); return; } fs.write(fd, data, null, encoding, callback); } } }); s.write("after the retry\n"); process.on("exit", () => console.log(JSON.stringify({ text: fs.readFileSync("/work/lifetime/c.log", "utf8") })));

pending-flush.source: const fs = require("fs"); const s = new fs.Utf8Stream({ dest: "/work/lifetime/d.log", minLength: 100 }); s.write("flushed\n"); let called = false; s.flush(() => { called = true; }); process.on("exit", () => console.log(JSON.stringify({ called, text: fs.readFileSync("/work/lifetime/d.log", "utf8") })));

periodic-flush-crash.source: const fs = require("fs"); const s = new fs.Utf8Stream({ dest: "/work/lifetime/e.log", minLength: 100, periodicFlush: 50 }); s.write("x\n"); setTimeout(() => console.log("survived"), 200);
